cards.example_en: I need to make a telephone call to the clinic.
cards.example_zh: 我需要给诊所打个电话。

cards.example_en: Close your eyes and make a wish.
cards.example_zh: 闭上眼睛许个愿。

cards.example_en: Please make an effort to arrive early.
cards.example_zh: 请努力早一点到。

cards.example_en: It is easy to make friends in the club.
cards.example_zh: 在社团里很容易交朋友。

cards.example_en: Everyone can make mistakes in a new lesson.
cards.example_zh: 上新课时每个人都可能犯错。

cards.example_en: She wants to make money for a new bike.
cards.example_zh: 她想赚钱买一辆新自行车。

cards.example_en: You will make progress if you practise.
cards.example_zh: 如果练习，你就会取得进步。

cards.example_en: Make sure the windows are closed.
cards.example_zh: 确保窗户关好了。

cards.example_en: I make the bed every morning.
cards.example_zh: 我每天早上整理床铺。

cards.example_en: Do not make up a story to hide a mistake.
cards.example_zh: 别编故事来掩盖错误。

cards.example_en: I cannot make up my mind about the colour.
cards.example_zh: 我还没对颜色下定决心。

cards.example_en: She will make up her mind to join the team.
cards.example_zh: 她会拿定主意加入队伍。

cards.example_en: More than twenty people came to help.
cards.example_zh: 二十多个人来帮忙。

cards.example_en: Please say the sentence once again.
cards.example_zh: 请把这个句子再说一次。

cards.example_en: The buses left one after another.
cards.example_zh: 公交车一辆接一辆地离开了。

cards.example_en: Pay attention to the last example.
cards.example_zh: 注意最后一个例子。

cards.example_en: I will pay for the tickets.
cards.example_zh: 票钱我来付。

cards.example_en: Please pick up the paper on the floor.
cards.example_zh: 请把地上的纸捡起来。

cards.example_en: The child likes to play with blocks.
cards.example_zh: 孩子喜欢玩积木。

cards.example_en: It is rude to point at people.
cards.example_zh: 指着人是不礼貌的。

cards.example_en: Can you point out the error?
cards.example_zh: 你能指出这个错误吗？

cards.example_en: The signs point to the exit.
cards.example_zh: 这些牌子指向出口。

cards.example_en: We prepare for the exam every evening.
cards.example_zh: 我们每天晚上着手准备考试。

cards.example_en: Put away your books before you leave.
cards.example_zh: 离开前把书收好。

cards.example_en: Put down the heavy box, please.
cards.example_zh: 请放下这个重箱子。

cards.example_en: Put the milk into the fridge.
cards.example_zh: 把牛奶放进冰箱。

cards.example_en: We may put off the picnic if it rains.
cards.example_zh: 如果下雨，我们可能推迟野餐。

cards.example_en: Put on a coat. It is cold.
cards.example_zh: 穿上外套，天冷。

cards.example_en: She will put her heart into every drawing.
cards.example_zh: 她会全心投入每一幅画。

cards.example_en: Put out the fire before you leave camp.
cards.example_zh: 离开营地前把火熄灭。

cards.example_en: We put up a notice on the board.
cards.example_zh: 我们在布告栏上张贴了一则通知。

cards.example_en: We may run out of paper this afternoon.
cards.example_zh: 今天下午纸可能会用完。

cards.example_en: You should say sorry to your classmate.
cards.example_zh: 你应该向同学道歉。

cards.example_en: They search for the lost dog in the park.
cards.example_zh: 他们在公园里搜寻走失的狗。

cards.example_en: We will send for a doctor if the pain grows.
cards.example_zh: 如果疼痛加重，我们会派人去请医生。

cards.example_en: The country will send up another satellite.
cards.example_zh: 这个国家将再发射一颗卫星。

cards.example_en: We set off for the museum at eight.
cards.example_zh: 我们八点出发去博物馆。

cards.example_en: They set out early with a small bag.
cards.example_zh: 他们带一个小包很早动身。

cards.example_en: The school will set up a reading club.
cards.example_zh: 学校将建立一个读书社团。

cards.example_en: I share my snacks with my friends.
cards.example_zh: 我和朋友分享零食。

cards.example_en: Please show up ten minutes early.
cards.example_zh: 请早十分钟露面。

cards.example_en: So far, we have learned forty words.
cards.example_zh: 到目前为止，我们学了四十个词。

cards.example_en: May I speak to Mr Chen?
cards.example_zh: 我可以和陈老师说话吗？

cards.example_en: The letters UN stand for an organisation.
cards.example_zh: 字母 UN 代表一个组织。

cards.example_en: Stick to your plan, and do a little each day.
cards.example_zh: 坚持你的计划，每天做一点。

cards.example_en: Please stop the ball from rolling into the road.
cards.example_zh: 请别让球滚到马路上去。

cards.example_en: Let us take a break and drink some water.
cards.example_zh: 我们休息片刻，喝点水。
